newsitem.title: INDIA: India 12.59 pct bond dips further on RBI sale news.
newsitem.headline: India 12.59 pct bond dips further on RBI sale news.

text.p: The 12.59 percent government stock 2004 fell further in early trade on Tuesday in reaction to an the announcement the central bank will sell the stock on tap, dealers said.
The stock fell to 100.0 rupees from 100.25 earlier on Tuesday and the previous close of 101.40 rupees, they said.
Dealers attributed the fall to confusion on whether the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) planned to sell the stock at par or at a premium.
The RBI on Monday night said it would be selling this stock on tap from June 25.

"Payment for the stock will include alongwith the nominal value of stock applied for, the accrued coupon from the date of commencement of tenure of the stock, June 18, to the date of tendering application," the RBI said.
The 12.50 percent 2004 stock fell to 99.60 rupees from the last traded price of 100.20, dealers said.
